zh: 一轮扫描内处理的编号，在数组中的位置必须是递增的；能否在同一轮里接着处理 v+1，只取决于 v+1 是否在 v 的右边。
所以每当 v+1 的位置在 v 的左边，就必须（也只需要）开启新的一轮；答案等于“位置下降”的次数加 1。
读入排列时记录 position[值] = 下标；然后对 v = 1..n−1 统计 position[v+1] < position[v] 的个数，输出它加 1。n 可达 10⁶，注意使用快速输入和紧凑的整数数组。
en: Within one round the numbers processed must appear at increasing positions; whether v+1 can be processed in the same round as v depends only on whether v+1 lies to the right of v.
So whenever v+1 sits to the left of v, a new round must start, and nothing else forces one; the answer is the number of such position drops plus 1.

While reading the permutation, record position[value] = index; then count v = 1..n-1 with position[v+1] < position[v] and print that count plus 1. n can reach 10^6, so use fast input and a compact integer array.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Record the position of each number. One round is needed to start; every time pos[v+1] < pos[v], a new scan is required, adding a round.

## Proof of correctness

Within one round, only numbers at increasing positions can be visited. When the positions of consecutive numbers drop, the current round cannot continue, and a next round must be started and is sufficient, so the answer is the number of position drops plus 1.

## Complexity

O(n) time and O(n) auxiliary space, with positions stored in a compact integer array.
